MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. If b = 3, what is the value of 2b + 1? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 21
   D. 7

2. Which division fact belongs to the same family as 9 × 5 = 45? (1 mark)
   A. 45 ÷ 45 = 9
   B. 45 ÷ 9 = 5
   C. 45 ÷ 9 = 9
   D. 5 ÷ 9 = 45

3. In the number 7,958, the digit 9 is in which place? (1 mark)
   A. Tens
   B. Thousands
   C. Ones
   D. Hundreds

4. 38 eggs are packed in trays that each hold 5 eggs. How many trays are needed to pack all the eggs? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 9

5. What is 1 1/4 L + 2 1/2 L? (1 mark)
   A. 4 1/4 L
   B. 3 1/2 L
   C. 4 L
   D. 3 3/4 L

6. A floor tile has four equal sides and four square corners. What shape is it? (1 mark)
   A. Rectangle with unequal sides
   B. Square
   C. Oval
   D. Triangle

7. What is 6 m 15 cm − 2 m 50 cm? (1 mark)
   A. 3 m 65 cm
   B. 4 m 65 cm
   C. 3 m 55 cm
   D. 3 m 75 cm

8. What do we call the point where the two arms of an angle meet? (1 mark)
   A. The vertex
   B. The side
   C. The edge
   D. The arm

9. A hundred square has 60 of its small squares shaded. Which decimal shows the shaded part? (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 6
   C. 0.06
   D. 0.6

10. What is a good thing to do when a shopkeeper gives you change? (1 mark)
   A. Throw it away
   B. Count it to check that it is correct
   C. Ask for more than you are owed
   D. Leave without looking

11. What is 1/2 kg + 3 kg? (1 mark)
   A. 3 1/4 kg
   B. 4 kg
   C. 3 1/2 kg
   D. 3 3/4 kg

12. Kip faces North and makes a half turn. Which way does he face now? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. South
   C. East
   D. West

13. Kip faces West and makes a half turn. Which way does he face now? (1 mark)
   A. West
   B. South
   C. North
   D. East

14. One unit costs Ksh 65. What is the cost of 3 exercise books? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 205
   B. Ksh 130
   C. Ksh 195
   D. Ksh 68

15. How long is a lesson that starts at 11:20 a.m. and ends at 1:05 p.m.? (1 mark)
   A. 2 h 45 min
   B. 1 h 45 min
   C. 1 h 55 min
   D. 1 h 30 min

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Wafula has 20 goats. One fifth of them are brown. How many goats are brown? Show your working. (3 marks)

17. The table shows football 5, netball 3, athletics 1 and swimming 1 for 10 pupils. Which sport is the most popular? How many pupils chose netball or athletics? (3 marks)

18. (a) Write 3 tenths and 5 hundredths as a decimal. (b) Write 7 hundredths as a decimal. (c) Arrange 0.35, 0.5, 0.07 and 0.29 from the smallest to the largest. (5 marks)

19. A store stacks boxes 6 in a row, 3 rows deep and 2 layers high. How many boxes are in the stack? Give one safety rule for stacking. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 7
   Replace the letter by its value and work it out. The answer is 7.

2. B — 45 ÷ 9 = 5
   Division undoes multiplication. Since 9 × 5 = 45, we know 45 ÷ 9 = 5 and 45 ÷ 5 = 9.

3. D — Hundreds
   Counting from the right the places are ones, tens, hundreds, thousands and ten thousands. The digit 9 is in the hundreds place.

4. B — 8
   38 ÷ 5 = 7 remainder 3. The 3 left-over eggs need one more tray, so 8 trays are needed.

5. D — 3 3/4 L
   Work with the whole litres first and then the parts. 1 1/4 L + 2 1/2 L = 3 3/4 L.

6. B — Square
   Four equal sides and four right angles make a square.

7. A — 3 m 65 cm
   615 − 250 = 365 cm = 3 m 65 cm.

8. A — The vertex
   The arms of an angle meet at a point called the vertex.

9. D — 0.6
   60 out of 100 squares is 60/100 = 0.6.

10. B — Count it to check that it is correct
   Counting the change carefully is honest and helps avoid mistakes.

11. C — 3 1/2 kg
   Work with the whole kilograms first and then the parts. 1/2 kg + 3 kg = 3 1/2 kg.

12. B — South
   Going clockwise the order is North, East, South, West. Going anticlockwise it is North, West, South, East. North followed by a half turn gives South.

13. D — East
   Going clockwise the order is North, East, South, West. Going anticlockwise it is North, West, South, East. West followed by a half turn gives East.

14. C — Ksh 195
   Cost = number × price = 3 × 65 = Ksh 195.

15. B — 1 h 45 min
   Count on from 11:20 a.m. to 1:05 p.m.. The total is 1 h 45 min.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: 4 goats
   Working / marking points: 20 ÷ 5 = 4 (2 marks) and 1 × 4 = 4 goats (1 mark).

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Football is the most popular. 3 + 1 = 4 pupils chose netball or athletics.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for football, 1 mark for 3 + 1, 1 mark for 4.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: (a) 0.35 (b) 0.07 (c) 0.07, 0.29, 0.35, 0.5
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for (a), 1 mark for (b), 3 marks for (c) (0.07 first, 0.5 last, and the middle two in order).

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: 36 boxes. Put heavy boxes at the bottom (or do not stack too high).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 6 × 3 = 18, 1 mark for 18 × 2, 1 mark for 36, 1 mark for a sensible safety rule.
